questions.q: What does a receipt confirm, as distinct from an invoice?
options: The receipt confirms the supplier's financial claim, the same as the invoice
A receipt replaces the need for a purchase order entirely
A receipt and an invoice are the same document in Oracle Fusion Cloud
The receipt confirms physical reality - that goods arrived or a service was performed - separate from the supplier's financial claim on the invoice
questions.explain: A receipt records physical confirmation of delivery or service performance, which is a distinct event from the invoice's financial claim.

questions.q: Why does keeping the receipt separate from the invoice matter later in this course?
options: It is what makes three-way matching possible, since the invoice can be checked against both the purchase order and the actual receipt
It has no real impact on anything downstream
It prevents the purchase order from ever being closed
It eliminates the need for an AP processor
questions.explain: Having a separate receipt document is what enables three-way matching - comparing the invoice against both the order and what was actually received.

questions.q: How does receiving a service purchase order typically differ from receiving goods?
options: There is no difference; both always require counting a physical quantity
Since there is often no physical quantity to count, someone certifies that the service (or a percentage of it) was performed instead
Service purchase orders never require any receiving step at all
Service receipts can only be created by the original requester
questions.explain: Service receiving typically relies on certification that work was performed, rather than counting a physical quantity.

questions.q: What does Priya confirm when creating the receipt for the bearing shipment?
options: Only the supplier's bank account number
The GL account that will eventually be debited on the invoice
The purchase order and schedule, the quantity received, the receiving location, and the transaction date
The requester's job title
questions.explain: Creating a receipt requires confirming which PO/schedule it is against, the quantity received, the receiving location, and the date.

questions.q: Why does Priya use the full receiving flow instead of express receipt for this shipment?
options: Because express receipt does not exist in Oracle Fusion Cloud
Because this shipment is routed for inspection, which requires more than the minimal data entry of express receipt
Because Meridian requires a paper form instead
Because the purchase order has not yet been approved
questions.explain: Express receipt is meant for simple, complete shipments with no inspection; LTV's bearing order is routed for inspection, so the full receiving flow applies.
